title: seseli libanotis var. alpicola
intro: Seseli libanotis var. alpicola, commonly known as Alpinesedanum, is a variant of the Seseli libanotis plant species, which belongs to the carrot family (Apiaceae). This plant is known for its therapeutic properties and has been used in traditional medicine for centuries. The health benefits of Seseli libanotis var. alpicola include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which help to relieve muscle spasms, reduce inflammation, and fight off infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include seselin, apiol, and other essential oils, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as sedative, anticonvulsant, and expectorant effects.
